text: Hello everyone, welcome to our English lesson.Boys and girls, last several lessons, we did some reading, listening and speaking about how to live a healthier life.Today we are going to do some writing about the topic.Before we start our lesson, please check if we have these things.Your student's book, your notebook, worksheet and pens with you.请准备好你的课本,笔记本,学习单,和笔。Are you ready?OK, now let's start.As we all know, Joe always has a headache.It's because he watches too much television.Then, how many times a day does he watch television?Yes, you are right.He watches television four times a day.The word time here means 次数。Now, Dr.Cheng and Joe are talking about Joe's activities.Listen carefully and fill out the missing words.Please take out your worksheet and finish task one.Ready?Start.How often do you watch television?The words are how often.We use how often to ask about frequency.我们用 how often 询问做某事的频率。What's Joe's answer to the question?Yes, four times a day.Now, let's go on listening to the dialogue between Dr.Cheng and Joe.How often do you exercise?I exercise once a month.How often does Joe exercise?He exercises once a month.Look at the calendar.Do you know the meaning of the word once?Yes, it means 一次。Let's read after the recording.Once.Again.How to say 两次 in English?Yes, twice.So, you see, we can use how often to ask about frequency.And we talk about how often we do something with once, twice, three times, etc.Now, Joe is telling Dr.Cheng more about his activities.Read the calendar and write down the sentences to show how often Joe does these things.For example, you can find one red circle in the calendar.It means Joe plays basketball once a month.So, you can write the sentence down like this.Take out your worksheet.Please finish task two.You will have one minute.Now, let's check.Yes, he does some reading twice a month.Oh, he doesn't do much reading.Do you think it's a good habit?No, I'm afraid not.Next, he eats fried chicken wings five times a month.Do you like eating fried food?Maybe some of you say yes.The last one.He never washes his clothes.Well, what do you think of Joe's habits?Terrible.I think so, too.We know that Joe never washes his clothes.Washing clothes is part of the housework.Look at the word housework.You all know the meanings of house and work.If these two words are put together to form one word, can you guess the meaning?Yes, it means 家务活。Let's take a look at Joe's two other habits.He goes to bed late three times a week.That means he doesn't have enough sleep.It's really bad for his health.We know he doesn't exercise very often.See, he practices swimming only twice a year.If you practice doing something, it means you do something again and again to do it better.Yeah, you are right.Here, practice means 练习。Now please write down a dialogue about Joe's habits.Take out your worksheet and finish task three.Ready, start.Have you finished?Miley has sent me her dialogue.Let's read it together.How often does Joe go to bed late?How often does Joe practice swimming?He practices swimming twice a year.How often does Joe help do the housework?He never helps do the housework.You did a good job.Look at the table.Since we know that Joe's habits are not quite good,can you give Joe some suggestions?Please write them down on your worksheet.Finish task four.You have one minute for
